title: Django 4.1.11 release notes | Django documentation | Django
content:
Django 4.1.11 fixes a security issue with severity “moderate” in 4.1.10.

django.utils.encoding.uri_to_iri() was subject to potential denial of service attack via certain inputs with a very large number of Unicode characters.

headings.text: CVE-2023-41164: Potential denial of service vulnerability in django.utils.encoding.uri_to_iri()¶
